mapper.select: /* loadUsrByUsername */ SELECT * FROM tb_user tu WHERE tu.delete_at = 'N' AND tu.user_id = #{userId}
/* isDuplicate */ SELECT IF(COUNT(*) > 0, 1, 0) FROM tb_user tu WHERE tu.user_id = #{value} AND tu.delete_at = 'N'
/* selectByMember */ SELECT tu.idx , tu.user_id , tu.nm , tu.role , tu.email , tu.phone , tu.delete_at , tu.created_at , tu.updated_at FROM tb_user tu WHERE tu.idx = #{idx} AND tu.delete_at = 'N'

/* selectByAllMember */ SELECT tu.idx , tu.user_id , tu.nm , tu.role , tu.email , tu.phone , tu.delete_at , tu.created_at , tu.updated_at FROM tb_user tu WHERE tu.delete_at = 'N' ORDER BY tu.created_at desc
